info.title: Tatame API
info.description: Identity (spec 001-auth) and enrollment (spec 003) surfaces. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json with stable `code`s.

refreshToken.description: Only for `body` transport; web gets the httpOnly cookie

code.description: TOTP code or single-use recovery code

refreshToken.description: Required for body transport; web uses the cookie
Only for `body` transport; web gets the httpOnly cookie

recoveryCodes.description: Single-use recovery codes — shown exactly once

dependents.description: Guardian (responsável) invites only: minor dependents enrolled with the guardian. Consumed by the enrollment slice.

refreshToken.description: Always in the body — the client stores it per its platform contract

enrollmentSkipped.description: True when the invite-bound class was full (or archived) at accept time: signup succeeded, the enrollment was skipped (spec 003, story 39)

token.description: Raw invite token — returned exactly once

refreshToken.description: Always in the body: the platform refresh cookie stays untouched

badge.description: Derived: pendente = record not yet claimed by a login

guardianId.description: Required when the student is a minor (minor ⇒ guardian rule)

movedStudentIds.description: Every selected student — the move is atomic

email.description: Reused cross-tenant when an account already exists

userCreated.description: False when an existing account was reused by email

passwordEmailSent.description: True when the set-your-password email was dispatched (no credential yet)

professorUserId.description: Must hold an active professor membership

classId.description: Accepted age-suggested class. Registration succeeds even when it is full — the enrollment is skipped (story 34).

enrolled.description: False when no class was accepted or the accepted class was full (story 34)

suggestion.description: Null when no active age-matching class with a free slot exists
